body: Credibility-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.71 (naive sector base rate 0.72) that: Sansera FY27 consolidated operating margin is >18.4% (better than FY26). Probability set only by the pre-stated rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/AUTO_COMPONENTS_peer_comparison.md section 5): p0 = 0.72 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'margin', n=10); SAC -4.8 pts x weight 0.286 (N=8) -> p = 0.71. Evidence: Q3FY26 call (10-Feb-2026): 'our margin profile will continue to be better than the current year'; Q1FY27: 'inch towards 19%'. FY26 screener OPM 18.4% (company EBITDA 18.1%); H1FY27 screener 19.2%, company 19.3%. Resolution: YES if FY27 consolidated Operating Profit / Sales (screener; NSE XBRL second source) is > 18.4%, to one decimal. Source: screener.in + NSE XBRL consolidated. Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs the base rate, to test whether the credibility adjustment adds skill.

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.72 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'margin', n=10); SAC -4.8 pts x weight 0.286 (N=8) -> p = 0.71
data.adjustment_rule: p0 = leave-one-out pooled STRICT delivery rate (specificity-weighted share 'delivered'; partly=0) of the other 4 peers in the promise's category (all-category peer rate if <8 peer promises in that category). p = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC/100, 0.05, 0.95), N = company's scored promises, SAC in points (credit basis: delivered 1, partly 0.5; categories with n<5, or with <2 peers having data, pooled). P(base) = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = sector delivery rate for 'margin' promises among the other auto-component peers (strict: delivered only, specificity-weighted; n=10). No company-specific information.
data.resolution_rule: YES if FY27 consolidated Operating Profit / Sales (screener; NSE XBRL second source) is > 18.4%, to one decimal.

title: Paper call: Sansera FY27 consolidated operating margin is >18.4% (better than FY26)
